description: EE2: `pokemon.illusion` outlives a switch-out, and Neutralizing Gas skips the next BeforeSwitchIn. Zoroark starts under Illusion. Setup turn 1: it switches out for Blissey (being called back, its Illusion `End` keeps the illusion). Setup turn 2: Weezing-Galar (Neutralizing Gas) and Ditto (Limber) come in for Snorlax and Hariyama; Neutralizing Gas ends only the active Pokemon's illusions. The turn: Zoroark switches back in while the gas suppresses its ability, so `onBeforeSwitchIn` does not run and the old illusion stays; Ditto's Transform at it fails.
